# Next Cue: ADHD Routine Planner

> Next Cue is an ADHD routine app for iPhone. Break a routine into small steps, and tap I'm stuck to shrink any step to one tiny move you can start now.

## App

- [ADHD Routine App for iPhone | Next Cue: ADHD Routine Planner](https://jackwallner.com/ios/adhd/index.html.md): Next Cue is an ADHD routine app for iPhone. Break a routine into small steps, and tap I'm stuck to shrink any step to one tiny move you can start now.

## Guides

- [How to Start a Task When You Have ADHD: 7 Techniques](https://jackwallner.com/ios/adhd/how-to-start-a-task-with-adhd.html.md): How to start a task when you have ADHD: seven practical task initiation techniques, from smallest starts to if-then plans, citing NIMH, CDC and CHADD.
